messages:
maria: hey team — quick pass on the new capacity modal. attaching screenshot in thread (see the burst slider on the right). overall looks good but a few UX/accessibility things I noticed lee: nice! a couple of quick notes: 1) the GPU pool picker feels dense when there are 12+ pools; we should allow keyboard typeahead and group by region 2) the min/max steppers are easy to accidentally overshoot on arrow keys 3) SLO slider needs clearer guardrail copy (what happens if you drag below the recommended?) dan: re: keyboard typeahead — agreed. we should focus on a single input element that supports up/down arrows + typeahead. aria-live for the selection count would help screen reader users saying e.g., \"Pool: us-west-2-g1 (selected)\" ashley: accessibility nit: the burst toggle current label is just \"Burst\". Can we change to \"Burst capacity (temporary)\" and add an aria-describedby pointing to a short explanation? suggestion: aria-describedby="#burst-desc" with text: \"Burst capacity is ephemeral and billed at a premium rate. Use for short spikes.\" aria: copy tweak for the SLO guardrail - instead of \"Reduce to meet SLO\" maybe \"Automatically scale down to preserve latency SLOs\" — clearer for product copy. Also, show an inline tooltip on hover explaining how the SLO affects min vs burst decisions. lee: UX microcopy for min/max stepper: show units and cost estimate on hover. Example small label: \"Min: 2 GPUs (baseline) — est $0.42/hour\". For keyboard: when user holds arrow, step size should increase after 6 steps (1,1,1,1,1,1 -> then +2,+2). prevents long holds from overshooting quickly. maria: Dan, can you add a quick proto for keyboard behavior? Lee, can you mock the grouped pool list and the new labels? Ashley, can you review ARIA ids? I'd like to avoid introducing new modals for explanations if possible (use inline tooltips) staging-bot: deploy scheduled: ui/capacity-modal-v3 -> staging at 21:15 UTC. Tests: keyboard navigation, screenreader smoke test. dan: quick proto note: I'll attach a short keyboard demo gif later but here's the aria suggestion snippet: ```
us-west-2-g1
``` ashley: also flagging contrast on the SLO thumb: current thumb color is 40% contrast on the panel background. needs to meet 4.5:1 for interactive elements. Suggest moving to the brand-600 or adding a 1px outline for focus. aria: small edge case: if burst is enabled but selected pool has no burst-capable instances, show an inline alert: \"Burst not available for this pool — automatically routing to fallback pool\" with a link to change pool. don't bury that message in the logs. lee: good call. Also accessibility for the pool list: ensure the compact view still has 44px tap targets on mobile. We can collapse meta (region, cost) beneath the pool name but keep touch area large. maria: ok action items summed: dan -> keyboard proto + gif, lee -> grouped pool list mock + updated copy, ashley -> ARIA ids + contrast check, aria -> SLO tooltip copy + fallback alert copy. i'll create a follow-up ticket and sync in tomorrow's design review. thanks all :thumbsup: ashley: +1. I'll run a quick axe scan on staging once deployed. lee: will include a small visual diff for the burst label change. maria: perfect — let's keep the scaffolding small and prefer inline tooltips over extra modals. if anyone finds unexpected failure cases after staging deploy ping me directly. staging-bot: deploy started: ui/capacity-modal-v3 -> staging
